author: Epic Games
description:
How have the returning characters of CONTROL changed, and what fresh perspectives can our new characters bring to the table? Join us in the final Development Diary episode to hear the cast of CONTROL Resonant dive deep into the characters they play.   

Go behind the scenes of CONTROL Resonant with the development team, and learn how CONTROL Resonant builds on the foundations that CONTROL set.  

CONTROL Resonant launches September 24, 2026 on Epic Games Store. Developed and published by Remedy Entertainment. https://epic.gm/control-resonant
title: CONTROL Resonant | Meet The Cast | Development Diary
